title: Salon marketing ideas - hair & beauty salon advertising ideas

facts.fact: Per the page, over 90% of consumers check online reviews before booking a new stylist (no source is cited for this figure).
facts.quote: Over 90% of consumers check online reviews before booking a new stylist.

facts.fact: The article was published on May 15, 2026, by Elise Hollinshead.
According to the page, Booksy automatically prompts clients to leave a review right after their appointment (a vendor feature claim).
facts.quote: Booksy automatically prompts clients to leave a review right after their appointment.

facts.fact: According to the page, Booksy profiles can be linked to Google's Reserve with Google feature, letting searchers book directly from Google Maps.
facts.quote: Link your profile to scheduling software like Booksy that supports _Reserve with Google_.

facts.fact: According to the page, Google regularly ranks trusted directories such as Booksy at the top of search results, often above individual salon websites (a vendor claim, no figures given).
facts.quote: Google regularly ranks trusted directories like Booksy right at the top of the page, often above individual salon websites.
